title: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders
abstract: Representation autoencoders (RAEs) reuse features from a pretrained visual encoder as reconstruction and diffusion latents, integrating strong visual representations into image generation. However, RAEs still need to decide which encoder layers form the shared latent space for the generator and pixel decoder. This choice involves a trade-off: shallower layers tend to preserve fine pixel details better, while deeper layers tend to yield better generation metrics. A fixed heuristic layer fusion therefore couples two stages that benefit from different information. We introduce FuseReg, which replaces heuristic feature selection with training over random subsets of encoder layers. We theoretically analyze the underlying mechanism: subset sampling preserves the full-layer latent mean in expectation while explicitly penalizing sensitivity to cross-layer disagreement. On ImageNet-256 with DINOv3-L, a single FuseReg decoder reconstructs from full, sparse, and single-layer fusions without retraining, achieving higher PSNR than decoders specialized to fixed fusions. This flexibility also benefits generation: decoder replacement alone reduces unguided gFID by 27% with an unchanged RAEv2 DiT-XL generator. Applying FuseReg to both stages also reduces unguided gFID by 29% on DiT-Base. The reconstruction and generation benefits also extend to other encoder families. FuseReg narrows the reconstruction-generation gap without additional training cost or architectural changes.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a graduate course on Computer Vision and Neural Networks, today’s lecture is on FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction–Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders. Work such as Diffusion Transformers with Representation Autoencoders and Improved Baselines with Representation Autoencoders reflects a trend toward using pretrained visual features for image generation. This paper, from researchers affiliated with USC and Brown, asks how to combine those features without forcing reconstruction and generation to rely on the same fixed blend. I see Noah raising a hand. Go ahead, Noah.
segments.zh: 在一门计算机视觉与神经网络的研究生课程上，今天的讲座讲的是FuseReg：通过正则化层融合来缓解表征自编码器中的重建-生成鸿沟。像《带表征自编码器的扩散Transformer》和《带表征自编码器的改进基线》这样的工作，反映出一种趋势，就是用预训练视觉特征来做图像生成。这篇论文来自南加州大学和布朗大学的研究者，它问的是：怎样才能把这些特征组合起来，而不强迫重建和生成依赖同一种固定混合方式。我看到Noah举手了。Noah，你说吧。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does the choice of encoder layers matter so much for image generation?
segments.zh: 教授您好，为什么编码器层的选择对图像生成这么重要？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because different depths preserve different information. Earlier encoder layers tend to retain spatial detail, while later layers represent more abstract semantic content. A reconstruction decoder benefits from details that help recover pixels; a diffusion generator may find a more semantic, stable representation easier to model. If both components must use one fixed fusion, improving one objective can make the other harder. FuseReg treats this tension as a robustness problem rather than searching for one universally best fusion.
segments.zh: 因为不同深度保留的信息不一样。靠前的编码器层往往保留空间细节，靠后的层则表征更抽象的语义内容。重建解码器受益于有助于恢复像素的细节；扩散生成器则可能觉得更语义化、更稳定的表征更容易建模。如果两个组件必须共用一种固定融合方式，那优化其中一个目标就可能让另一个更难。FuseReg把这种张力当作一个鲁棒性问题来处理，而不是去寻找一种放之四海而皆准的最优融合。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The basic idea is to train downstream models on changing combinations of layers. The encoder stays frozen, and each training example uses a randomly selected, nonempty subset of its 23 layers. Those selected features are averaged, so the model sees varied fusions rather than one permanent recipe. At inference, the usual input can still include every layer. The goal is a decoder and generator that remain useful when the layer mixture changes.
segments.zh: 基本思路是让下游模型在变化的层组合上训练。编码器保持冻结，每个训练样本都从它的23层里随机选一个非空子集。选中的特征取平均，这样模型看到的是各种不同的融合方式，而不是一个固定配方。推理时，输入仍然可以包含所有层。目标是让解码器和生成器在层组合发生变化时依然好用。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does random selection change the average representation the models see?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：随机选择会改变模型看到的平均表示吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is a key design choice: the selected layers are averaged by their count. The paper proves that this normalized random fusion has the same expected representation as the full-layer mean. Increasing the drop rate therefore increases variation without shifting the average. Their analysis further shows that this variation is concentrated along directions where layers disagree, rather than adding undirected noise. In that sense, the method regularizes dependence on particular layer combinations.
segments.zh: 这是一个关键的设计选择：选中的层按其数量取平均。论文证明了这种归一化的随机融合与全层平均具有相同的期望表示。因此，提高丢弃率会增加变化，但不会偏移均值。他们的分析进一步表明，这种变化集中在各层意见不一致的方向上，而不是添加无方向的噪声。从这个意义上说，该方法对特定层组合的依赖起到了正则化作用。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The pixel decoder is trained to reconstruct images from these changing fusions, using pixelwise error, perceptual loss, and an adversarial loss. The diffusion transformer gets a related but distinct task: it receives a noisy, randomly fused representation and learns to predict the full-layer aggregate. The two components have separate drop rates, since the best degree of robustness for pixel reconstruction need not be the best for generation.
segments.zh: 像素解码器的训练目标是从这些不断变化的融合表示中重建图像，用到了逐像素误差、感知损失和对抗损失。扩散Transformer的任务相关但不同：它接收一个带噪的、随机融合的表示，学习预测全层聚合结果。这两个组件有各自的drop rate，因为对像素重建来说最优的鲁棒程度，未必对生成也是最优的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify why the diffusion model predicts the full-layer target instead of the sampled fusion?
segments.zh: 你能解释一下，为什么扩散模型预测的是全层目标，而不是采样得到的融合结果吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Predicting a shared full-layer target encourages the generator to map different valid layer mixtures toward a common representation. It avoids teaching the generator that every sampled subset defines a different destination. In experiments on ImageNet at 256 by 256 resolution, the team tests reconstruction, class-conditional generation, and decoder replacement. Holding the generator’s sampled latents fixed while swapping decoders is especially useful: it isolates how decoder robustness alone affects the resulting images.
segments.zh: 预测一个共享的全层目标，会促使生成器把不同的有效层组合映射到同一个共同表示上。这样就避免了让生成器误以为每个采样得到的子集都对应一个不同的目标。在256乘256分辨率的ImageNet实验中，团队测试了重建、类别条件生成和编码器替换。在固定生成器采样潜变量的同时替换编码器尤其有用：它能单独考察编码器鲁棒性本身如何影响生成的图像。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The reconstruction results show the contrast clearly. A fixed-fusion decoder can perform well on its training mixture, then deteriorate sharply on a different one. The FuseReg decoder reaches 27.52 decibels of P-S-N-R on the full fusion, 23.77 on a seven-layer fusion, and 25.13 on a single layer. Its reconstruction F-I-D stays below 0.6 across those inputs. That is a modest trade from peak specialization toward much broader compatibility.
segments.zh: 重建结果把这种对比体现得很清楚。固定融合解码器在自己的训练混合上表现很好，换一种混合就会急剧退化。FuseReg解码器在全融合上达到27.52分贝的PSNR，在七层融合上是23.77，在单层上是25.13。它在这些输入上的重建FID都保持在0.6以下。这是从峰值专精向更广泛兼容性的一次温和取舍。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hold on, do those reconstruction gains translate into better generated images, or only better pixels?
segments.zh: 等等，这些重建上的提升真的能转化成更好的生成图像吗，还是说只是像素层面更好看而已？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They can translate into better generated images. With the generator and latents held fixed, replacing the standard decoder with a FuseReg decoder reduces unguided g-F-I-D from 3.01 to 2.21 on the full fusion. On a shifted seven-layer fusion, it drops from 27.73 to 1.92. Joint training also helps: for the base diffusion transformer, decoder and generator regularization together lower g-F-I-D from 13.96 to 9.93. The preferred rates vary by model and metric.
segments.zh: 它们确实能转化为更好的生成图像。在生成器和潜变量保持不变的情况下，把标准解码器换成FuseReg解码器后，完整融合上的无引导g-F-I-D从3.01降到了2.21。在偏移的七层融合上，则从27.73降到了1.92。联合训练也有帮助：对于基础扩散Transformer，解码器和生成器正则化一起把g-F-I-D从13.96降到了9.93。最佳比例因模型和指标而异。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The practical implication is that decoder mismatch can become a generation bottleneck, even when the generator itself is unchanged. A decoder that tolerates sparse or altered features can make one pretrained encoder more flexible to use. But these results are not a guarantee that more randomization is always better: small drop rates sometimes hurt, and the larger model’s best settings depend on guidance and whether the metric is g-F-I-D or Inception Score.
segments.zh: 实际意义在于，即便生成器本身没变，解码器不匹配也可能成为生成的瓶颈。一个能容忍稀疏或改变后特征的解码器，可以让同一个预训练编码器用起来更灵活。但这些结果并不保证随机化越多就越好：小的丢弃率有时反而有害，而较大模型的最佳设置取决于引导方式，以及指标用的是 g-F-I-D 还是 Inception Score。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How far can we generalize this, given the experiments use one encoder and ImageNet?
segments.zh: 考虑到实验只用了单一编码器和ImageNet，这个结论能推广到什么程度？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is an important limitation. The experiments focus on one frozen Dino V-three encoder, ImageNet at one resolution, and two diffusion-transformer scales. The theoretical decompositions are exact for linear predictors with squared loss, while the actual networks are nonlinear and use mixed objectives. So the theory explains a plausible mechanism, but does not establish every detail of training behavior. Tests across encoders, datasets, resolutions, and modalities would show how broadly the approach transfers.
segments.zh: 这是一个重要的局限。实验只聚焦于一个冻结的 DINOv3 编码器、单一分辨率的 ImageNet，以及两种扩散 Transformer 规模。理论分解对于使用平方损失的线性预测器是精确成立的，而实际网络是非线性的，并且使用混合目标。因此，理论解释了一个可能的机制，但并未确立训练行为的每一个细节。跨编码器、数据集、分辨率和模态的测试才能说明该方法能迁移到多广的范围。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Conceptually, FuseReg shifts layer fusion from a static choice to a distribution that downstream models learn to handle. That complements work such as Representation Alignment for Generation, which studies how pretrained features can guide diffusion training, while FuseReg focuses on robustness to the composition of those features. The distinction matters: alignment asks what representation is useful, while this paper asks whether models can remain effective across several reasonable representations.
segments.zh: 从概念上讲，FuseReg把层融合从一个静态选择变成了一个下游模型需要学会处理的分布。这与Representation Alignment for Generation等工作形成互补，后者研究预训练特征如何引导扩散训练，而FuseReg关注的是对这些特征组合的鲁棒性。这个区别很重要：对齐问的是什么样的表示有用，而这篇论文问的是模型能否在多种合理的表示下都保持有效。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the broader lesson is to train for variation in the representation interface, not just optimize one fusion?
segments.zh: 所以更广泛的启示是，要针对表示接口的变化来训练，而不是只优化某一种融合方式？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. FuseReg suggests that a fixed feature blend may hide fragility: a decoder can appear strong while depending heavily on one layer recipe. Training across normalized random subsets can reduce that dependence, and the generator can benefit from a shared target across those inputs. The memorable takeaway is simple: instead of choosing one perfect fusion, teach the model to work with many. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 完全正确。FuseReg 表明，固定的特征融合可能掩盖脆弱性：一个解码器表面上很强，实际上却严重依赖某一种层组合方案。在归一化的随机子集上训练可以降低这种依赖，而生成器也能从这些输入共享同一个目标中获益。最值得记住的一点很简单：与其挑选一种完美的融合方式，不如让模型学会适应多种融合。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以询问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
